title: Luxurious 4BR Home, Mins to DT, Pet Friendly!
description:
✔️ Minutes from Downtown Nashville, parks, and local shopping
✔️ Modern home with wet bar and spacious gathering areas
✔️ 4 bedrooms, 3 baths — sleeps up to 10
✔️ Smart TVs, full kitchen, and family-friendly amenities
✔️ Pet-friendly home perfect for groups and extended stays

The space
• The Vivianne is your stylish Nashville retreat with plenty of room for families, friends, and group getaways
• Start your morning with coffee before heading downtown to explore Music City's restaurants, live music, and attractions
• Return home to prepare dinner in the modern kitchen, gather around the dining table, or enjoy drinks at the wet bar
• Spacious bedrooms, thoughtful finishes, and flexible sleeping arrangements make everyone feel at home
• Ideal for families, business travelers, friend groups, and longer Nashville stays

🌅 Indoor & Outdoor Living
• Comfortable living spaces designed for gathering
• Dedicated dining room for shared meals
• Wet bar for entertaining
• Smart TVs in three bedrooms
• Free WiFi throughout the home

🛏️ Bedrooms & Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 10)
• This home includes 4 bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms
• Bedroom 1: Queen bed plus 2 XL twin beds; sleeps up to 4
• Bedroom 2: Full bed, Smart TV; sleeps 2
• Bedroom 3: Queen bed, Smart TV; sleeps 2
• Bedroom 4: Queen bed, Smart TV, ensuite bathroom; sleeps 2
Bathrooms:
• Guest Bathroom 1: Single vanity, standing shower
• Guest Bathroom 2: Single vanity, shower/tub combo
• Ensuite Bathroom: Single vanity, walk-in shower

🍳 Kitchen & Dining
• Fully equipped kitchen with electric range
• Full-size refrigerator and oversized sink
• Bar counter seating
• Dedicated dining room for group meals
• Cookware, bakeware, dishes, and utensils are provided
• Salt, pepper, and cooking oil are not provided

🏖️ What's Included
• Fresh bed linens and bath towels
• Starter supply of toiletries and paper goods
• Free WiFi throughout the home
• Long-term stays welcome
• Highchair and baby monitor available upon request

📍 Location Highlights
• Convenient location near Downtown Nashville
• Close to neighborhood parks and local shopping
• Easy access to Broadway, restaurants, live music, and popular attractions
• Great home base for exploring Music City

🚗 Parking, Safety & Notes
• Parking is available for up to 4 vehicles in the driveway and on the street. Please only use these areas; additional parking is not available.
• Stairs are required to access the main entrance as well as some bedrooms.
• This home is pet friendly. One pet is allowed per stay. Please note that there is an additional Pet Fee of $75 per pet that is not included in your final booking cost. To pay your Pet Fee, please contact the Customer Care Team after booking.
• Check in is at 4:00 PM and checkout is at 10:00 AM.
